title: Jeweled Herbed Mediterranean Goats Cheese Skewers
description: A romantic Mediterranean dish featuring goats cheese, fresh herbs, and a hint of citrus, perfect for a summer evening. This dish is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the crumbled goats cheese, chopped parsley, chopped mint, lemon zest, and minced garlic.
Thread a small amount of the cheese mixture onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Drizzle the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the skewers on the preheated grill and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until the cheese is slightly melted.
While the skewers are cooking, toast the pine nuts in a dry pan over medium heat.
Once the skewers are cooked, remove them from the grill and place them on the soaked cedar planks.
Garnish the skewers with toasted pine nuts and pomegranate seeds.
